title: 第3章 双灵根第4章 仙家
content_zh:
重生之地相距藏宝点有些距离且路途上有一定妖兽危险，在没达到炼气三重前不适合去拿
暂时摒弃杂念，杨威入定运转心法
伴随着丹田之中溢出丝丝法力，微微火光自他周身环绕
随后剑指一挥手臂之上便形成一道红火菱形虚影，右手顷刻化作了一柄烈焰神兵
“紫霞神功”
前三重具象化表现便是“聚气成刃”
，单独的上部功法炼至圆满可达玄阶中期
当然以杨威目前的法力只能堪堪施展出第一重的功力，要想变得更强还得继续提升修为才行
“威哥你在哪？
就在杨威打坐调息之时，一只小手胡乱摸索了着床单，原来是翠翠下意识的在寻他
这具身体还承受不起长时间的练功，有些累了继续睡吧，杨威顺势滑入被窝里
随后整个人便如同被水蛇死死缠住，就连两腿都被夹住动弹不得
“好舒服……
半梦半醒的少女呓语着
经过刚才的施法，茅草屋内已暖和不少
对于这糟糕的睡姿杨威没有抗拒，他知道两人从小便睡一张床，从未有过男女之事
此刻这具身体有些生理上的反应可以理解，毕竟都是情窦初开的年纪
邪念刚一滋生便被杨威强大的意志镇压了，鬼使神差间他想替这孩子测一下灵根
单手放在滑腻的小腹之上随后催动微弱神识
“什么？双灵根！

杨威瞳孔猛的一震
随后又是一探，蓝绿两道虚影又一次浮现眼前
以他多年的经验是不会看错的，这就是木灵根和水灵根，虽然从品相上看比较薄弱，却是实打实的双灵根。
灵根是修士的天资基础，越是高级就越适合修行，就好比现世中的智力越高读书越厉害一样
修仙界对于资质更有着明确的三六九等之分
从低到高大致分为五种
“五灵根”
别名“伪灵根”
，想要入道都困难，目前杨威见过的五灵根修士都与凡人无异
“四灵根”
别名“杂灵根”
，修为天赋极差，勉强入道后，想要修至炼气高段便难如登天
“三灵根”
又称“中品灵根”
，勉强可以修行，各大宗门也会收些不错的弟子用作处理日常事务
“双灵根”
又叫“上品灵根”
，修行精较快是有望筑基的，也是有各大宗门争取的人才，成长起来大多是宗门里的中高层
“单灵根”
便是大名鼎鼎的“天灵根”
content_en:
The place of rebirth is some distance away from the treasure cache and there are certain dangers of monsters on the road. It is not suitable to go there before reaching the third level of Qi refining.
Temporarily abandoning distracting thoughts, Yang Wei entered into concentration and circulated his mind.
As a trace of mana overflowed from his dantian, a faint light of fire surrounded him.
Then with a wave of the sword, a red flaming diamond-shaped shadow formed on his arm, and his right hand instantly turned into a blazing magic weapon.
"The Magic Power of Zixia"
The first three levels of concrete expression are "gathering energy to form a blade"
, the upper part of the exercise alone can be practiced to perfection and can reach the mid-Xuan level.
Of course, Yang Wei's current magic power can only be used to display the first level of skills. If he wants to become stronger, he must continue to improve his cultivation level.
“Brother Wei, where are you?
While Yang Wei was meditating and adjusting his breath, a small hand fumbled randomly with the sheets. It turned out that Cuicui was subconsciously looking for him.
This body can't bear the long-term practice. If you are a little tired, you should continue to sleep. Yang Wei slid into bed.
Then the whole person felt as if he was tightly entangled by a water snake, and even his legs were clamped and unable to move.
"So comfortable...
The half-asleep girl murmurs
After the spell cast just now, the inside of the thatched house has become much warmer.
Yang Wei didn't resist this bad sleeping position. He knew that the two of them had slept on the same bed since they were young and had never had sex.
It is understandable that this body has some physiological reactions at this moment. After all, they are all at the age when they are in love.
As soon as the evil thoughts arose, they were suppressed by Yang Wei's strong will. By chance, he wanted to test the child's spiritual roots.
Put one hand on the smooth belly and then activate the weak consciousness
"What? Twin Spiritual Roots!
Yang Wei's pupils trembled violently
Then I took another look, and two phantoms, blue and green, appeared in front of me again.
With his many years of experience, he would not be mistaken. These are the wood spiritual roots and the water spiritual roots. Although they are relatively weak in appearance, they are real twin spiritual roots.
Spiritual roots are the foundation of a monk's talent. The more advanced they are, the more suitable they are for practice, just like the higher the intelligence in this world, the better at reading.
The world of cultivating immortals has a clear distinction between three, six and nine levels of qualifications.
They are roughly divided into five types from low to high
"Five Spiritual Roots"
Alias "Pseudo Spiritual Root"
, it is difficult to enter Taoism. The five spiritual root monks Yang Wei has seen so far are no different from ordinary people.
"Four Spiritual Roots"
Alias "Miscellaneous Spirit Root"
, the cultivation talent is extremely poor, after reluctantly entering the Taoism, it is difficult to reach the high level of Qi refining.
"Three Spiritual Roots"
Also known as "middle grade spiritual root"
, can barely practice, and each major sect will also accept some good disciples to handle daily affairs.
"Two spiritual roots"
Also called "High Grade Spiritual Root"
, it is possible to build a foundation quickly by cultivating the essence, and there are also talents that all major sects strive for. When they grow up, most of them will be middle-to-high-level people in the sect.
"Single Spiritual Root"
It is the famous "Tianling Root"
